answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (9.3.2026) The Commission has not received communications or reports indicating that such products have been refused market access, withdrawn, or had a change in classification in the EU because of the regulatory framework.

Furthermore, Member States have not reported safety concerns, market-surveillance actions or national restrictions relating to such products to the Commission, as actions related to market-surveillance fall under the competence of the Member States. On 16 December 2025, the Commission proposed a targeted simplification of the rules for medical devices, based on its evaluation of the current framework1.

This proposal aims to make the current rules for medical devices easier, faster and more effective to further promote competitiveness, innovation and a high-level of patient safety in this key sector.
